line.comment: * If Player is involved $race2 must be [Player].
* Expanded 2.2.1: Now calls SSOT. Nomad nicluded as they're neutral.
* Add-Ons 1.4.3: Clamp reputation points to between -1M to +1M and save both previous points and new points.
* The points need to be used to determine when to revoke favor and loyalty points, should reputation continue to drop.
* Lose all Loyalty and Favors when reputation drops below rank 0. Going to war drops reputation to below rank 0.
* Also fixed a bug where gaining rep while at negative will cause points to be lost! Now, we check if rank is less than 0 and if our reputation dropped. This check is needed if we're doing missions.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Removed random bonus Loyalty to ensure Loyalty is earned via meaningful actions.
* Report diplomatic losses, if any occurred.
